title: Baked Mushroom Dip
description: Sautéed mushrooms and onion folded into cream cheese, mayonnaise, garlic-herb seasoning and habanero cheese, baked until bubbling. Serve with chips, crackers or in a bread bowl.

steps.heading: Cook the Mushrooms
steps.text: Cook the mushrooms, butter and onion in a frying pan until most of the liquid has evaporated, about 10 minutes.

steps.heading: Mix
steps.text: In a bowl, combine the cream cheese, mayonnaise, seasoning and cheese. Add the mushroom mixture and mix well.

steps.heading: Bake
steps.text: Spread in a baking dish (about 9 inches, depending on depth) and bake at 350°F for 30 minutes. Garnish with green onion and serve with tortilla chips, crackers, or in a bread bowl.

notes: Slow-cooker option: instead of baking, cook on low for an hour before guests arrive.
